Task task-4ff03f64: Build a comprehensive, production-grade AI Creative Studio dashboard in static/ai_studio.html. Include:

2. Core Features:
   - Text Prompt Workspace with model selector dropdown (GPT-4, Claude 3, Llama 3) and temperature slider.

   - Media Assets Gallery with filter tabs (All, Images, Audio, Code) and lightbox preview modal.
